title: MediScanAI Human Benchmark Adjudication Schema
description: Formal schema for recording human clinical and nonclinical adjudication decisions on retrieval benchmark candidates, strictly separating preliminary AI hypotheses from human ground truth.

case_id.description: Canonical case identifier from candidate_queries.jsonl (MED-BENCH-001 through MED-BENCH-050).

query.description: Verbatim text of the benchmark query.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier of candidate evidence item (e.g., drug_53548, disease_chunk_101, or 'none' for unanswerable negative controls).

source_record_id.description: Raw 0-indexed line/record ID in the underlying source dataset (null for negative controls).

channel.description: Retrieval channel provenance from empirical retrieval pooling.

baseline_rank.description: Native rank in FAISS dense baseline channel (1-indexed), or null if not retrieved in top 5.

graph_rank.description: Native rank in Neo4j knowledge graph channel (1-indexed), or null if not retrieved in top 5.

proposed_grade.description: AI-proposed preliminary relevance grade (hypothesis for review, not verified truth).

proposed_rationale.description: AI-generated rationale explaining the proposed grade.

review_requirement.description: Triage gate defining required reviewer qualification (none for factual lookup; qualified_medical_review for clinical relevance).

human_decision.description: Human reviewer's explicit action on the proposed hypothesis.

reviewed_grade.description: Human reviewer's independent grade assignment. Must be an integer in [0, 3] once reviewed; null/blank while pending.

reviewer_id.description: Verified unique human reviewer identifier (e.g., dr_chen_md, pharm_smith_rph). Null/blank while pending.

reviewer_role.description: Declared role and competency tier of the human reviewer.

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of human review completion (e.g., 2026-10-15T14:30:00Z). Null while pending.

reviewer_rationale.description: Human reviewer's documented justification tied to query information need and clinical/regulatory evidence.

reviewer_confidence.description: Reviewer's degree of clinical or factual certainty.

supporting_source_url.description: Authoritative regulatory, guideline, or package insert URL verifying the human judgment.

adjudication_status.description: Operational review workflow state of the record.

adjudication_notes.description: Consensus notes, disagreement logs, or adjudication conference documentation.
